sources.title: Johanna Beach
sources.excerpt: Johanna Beach is an exposed ocean beach near Johanna, on the Great Ocean Road coast of south-western Victoria, Australia. The beach extends for approximately 3.6 kilometres (2.2 mi) between Slippery Point in the west and Rotten Point in the east, with the Johanna River crossing its central section before entering the Southern Ocean. Johanna Beach is a well-known surfing location and hosted the World Surfing Championships in 1970. It has also been used as an alternative competition venue for the Rip Curl Pro when conditions at Bells Beach were unsuitable.
